author: Thomas à Kempis
title: How we must stand and speak, in everything that we desire

verses.text: “My Son, speak thou thus in every matter, ‘Lord, if it please Thee, let this come to pass.
verses.modernizedText: “My Son, speak thus in every matter: ‘Lord, if it please You, let this come to pass.

verses.text: Lord, if this shall be for Thine honour, let it be done in Thy Name.
verses.modernizedText: Lord, if this will be for Your honor, let it be done in Your Name.

verses.text: Lord, if thou see it good for me, and approve it as useful, then grant me to use it for Thy honour.
verses.modernizedText: Lord, if You see it is good for me, and approve it as useful, then grant me to use it for Your honor.

verses.text: But if thou knowest that it shall be hurtful unto me, and not profitable for the health of my soul, take the desire away from me’!
verses.modernizedText: But if You know that it will be hurtful to me, and not profitable for the health of my soul, take the desire away from me’!

verses.text: For not every desire is from the Holy Ghost, although it appear to a man right and good.
verses.modernizedText: For not every desire is from the Holy Ghost, although it appears right and good to a man.

verses.text: It is difficult to judge with certainty whether a good or an evil spirit move thee to desire this or that, or whether thou art moved by thine own spirit.
verses.modernizedText: It is difficult to judge with certainty whether a good or an evil spirit moves you to desire this or that, or whether you are moved by your own spirit.

verses.text: Many have been deceived at the last, who seemed at the beginning to be moved by a good spirit.
verses.modernizedText: Many have been deceived in the end, who seemed at the beginning to be moved by a good spirit.

verses.text: “Therefore, whatsoever seemeth to thee desirable, thou must always desire and seek after it with the fear of God and humility of heart, and most of all, must altogether resign thyself, and commit all unto Me and say, ‘Lord, thou knowest what is best; let this or that be, according as Thou wilt.
verses.modernizedText: “Therefore, whatever seems desirable to you, you must always desire and seek it with the fear of God and humility of heart, and above all, must altogether resign yourself, and commit all to Me and say, ‘Lord, You know what is best; let this or that be, according to Your will.

verses.text: Give what Thou wilt, so much as Thou wilt, when Thou wilt.
verses.modernizedText: Give what You will, as much as You will, when You will.

verses.text: Do with me as Thou knowest best, and as best shall please Thee, and as shall be most to Thine honour.
verses.modernizedText: Do with me as You know best, and as will best please You, and as will be most to Your honor.

verses.text: Place me where Thou wilt, and freely work Thy will with me in all things.
verses.modernizedText: Place me where You will, and freely work Your will with me in all things.

verses.text: I am in Thine hand, and turn me in my course.
verses.modernizedText: I am in Your hand, and turn me in my course.

verses.text: Behold, I am Thy servant, ready for all things; for I desire to live not to myself but to Thee.
verses.modernizedText: Behold, I am Your servant, ready for all things; for I desire to live not to myself but to You.

verses.text: Oh, that I might live worthily and perfectly.’”
verses.modernizedText: Oh, that I might live worthily and perfectly.’”

verses.text: A PRAYER TO BE ENABLED TO DO GOD’S WILL PERFECTLY
verses.modernizedText: A PRAYER TO BE ENABLED TO DO GOD’S WILL PERFECTLY

verses.text: Grant me Thy grace, most merciful Jesus, that it may be with me, and work in me, and persevere with me, even unto the end.
verses.modernizedText: Grant me Your grace, most merciful Jesus, that it may be with me, and work in me, and persevere with me, even to the end.

verses.text: Grant that I may ever desire and wish whatsoever is most pleasing and dear unto Thee.
verses.modernizedText: Grant that I may ever desire and wish whatever is most pleasing and dear to You.

verses.text: Let Thy will be mine, and let my will alway follow Thine, and entirely accord with it.
verses.modernizedText: Let Your will be mine, and let my will always follow Yours, and entirely accord with it.

verses.text: May I choose and reject whatsoever Thou dost; yea, let it be impossible for me to choose or reject except according to Thy will.
verses.modernizedText: May I choose and reject whatever You do; indeed, let it be impossible for me to choose or reject except according to Your will.

verses.text: Grant that I may die to all worldly things, and for Thy sake love to be despised and unknown in this world.
verses.modernizedText: Grant that I may die to all worldly things, and for Your sake love to be despised and unknown in this world.

verses.text: Grant unto me, above all things that I can desire, to rest in Thee, and that in Thee my heart may be at peace.
verses.modernizedText: Grant me, above all things that I can desire, to rest in You, and that in You my heart may be at peace.

verses.text: Thou art the true peace of the heart, Thou alone its rest; apart from Thee all things are hard and unquiet.
verses.modernizedText: You are the true peace of the heart, You alone its rest; apart from You all things are hard and unquiet.

verses.text: In Thee alone, the supreme and eternal God, I will lay me down in peace and take my rest.(1) Amen.
verses.modernizedText: In You alone, the supreme and eternal God, I will lie down in peace and take my rest.(1) Amen.
